items.mainDefect: Adding getShortcut() as an abstract SPI method without a default breaks existing custom implementations.

secondary.defect: The shortcut documentation suggests three characters although the decoder requires exactly two.

Null shortcuts are not validated and cause server startup to fail when inserted into ConcurrentHashMap.
